text:
Alex: Heads-up — I just opened the deprecation / migration notice PR for v1->v2 (docs PR #8241). landing checklist inside.
Mira: 👍 link?
Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8241
Sam: Skimmed. main ask: update the code snippets for generate->responses rename and embed model swap. Also need a short migration table.
Alex: Right. I added a migration table draft at the top and a short sample for the Ruby SDK. worried about the embed vector dim note.
Jordan: For embeds: callout that alias "embed-small" -> "embed-ada-2x" and that dim changes from 1536 -> 1024. include an explicit resilience example for fallback.
Mira: We should add a config snippet for Dedicated customers showing model pinning to avoid surprise after swap.
Alex: Good call. Draft snippet:

```yaml
# pin to a model bundle for Dedicated
inference:
  model: "embed-ada-2x@2024-12-01"
  fallback: "embed-small"
```

Sam: Can we avoid hard dates in example? use `@stable` or `@pinned` placeholder so customers don't copy a stale date.
Alex: Updated to `@pinned`. pushed.
DocsBot: reminder: docs PR must include smoke test results in the PR body. Use `docs-smoke` CI.
Jordan: Also need note about token accounting differences after the responses API rename — tiny but important for cost calculators.
Mira: I'll add a short section: "Token accounting differences and what to expect" + example math for a 512-token prompt.
Sam: About SDK examples: the previous snippets used `client.generate()`; replace with `client.responses.create({ input })` across JS/Python/Go. Also add a one-liner compatibility shim for quick migrations.
Alex: Proposed shim for Node (added to PR):

```js
// compatibility shim
function generate(client, params) {
  return client.responses.create({ input: params.input, ...params });
}
```

Mira: Fine but comment it as temporary. we don't want it block tests.
Jordan: Who's owning the PR review and external comms draft? I can draft the deprecation email once docs land.
Alex: Jordan for comms, Mira for Dedicated snippet, Sam for SDK snippets across languages, I'll own the migration table and embed callouts.
Sam: I'll run a quick grep over repo to catch any lingering `generate(` references.
Mira: FYI: legal asked for an audit trail note for Private deployments; add a short blurb about audit log fields that will include "model_id" after swap.
Alex: Added a placeholder; can you paste the legal-approved copy into the PR, @Mira?
Mira: On it.
DocsBot: ci/status: docs-smoke queued.
Alex: Quick QA item: add a tiny playground example using streaming responses so users see function calling parity. I can write it tomorrow morning.
Jordan: For release timeline: propose soft-deprecation banner on the docs site in 3 business days after PR merge, and a 30-day user-facing sunset notice after that. I'll coordinate with comms.
Sam: One more thing — internal blog/demo needs updating. Can we add a task list at the bottom of the PR for DevEx to pick up? checkbox list?
Alex: Done. See the bottom of the PR body.
Mira: I fixed a broken crosslink too: /guides/embed -> /guides/embeddings. push in a follow-up commit.
Alex: Last check: anyone want to run the smoke locally? I can run the tests tonight if CI is flaky.
Sam: I'll run smoke in the morning and search/replace for `generate(` across examples.
Jordan: I'll draft the deprecation announcement and tag legal + trust for signoff.
Alex: Thanks all — merging plan: ship docs PR, tag release train, then Jordan sends announcement. If anyone finds a blocker, comment on the PR. :thumbsup:
Mira: Thanks — leaving a quick review now.
DocsBot: automated: PR #8241 updated — smoke results pending.
Alex: Merge window scheduled for 08:30 PT tomorrow.
Sam: noted.
